newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 8.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The Home Secretary Michael Howard has announced a whole raft of measures designed to tackle the problem of paedophilia, including a national register of paedophiles and a new law to prosecute those who commit child sex crimes abroad.
The outdoor advertising company More O'Ferrall has acquired US rival SHF Communications, in a 2.5m stg deal designed to give O'Ferrall a strong foothold in the American posters market.
ELECTION PLEDGE ON RATES BOOSTS YEN
Pledges from the Liberal Democratic Party in Japan to raise rates after the election pushed the yen up against world currencies today.
JARDINE FLEMING FACES KOWLOON FUND LOSS

Jardine Fleming Investment Management could lose the Kowloon Canton Railway Corporation pension fund contract, a week after losing the HK Jockey Club retirement fund following investigations of the company by Hong Kong and London regulators.
DOW STEALS A MARCH IN RACE WITH FOOTSIE

The Dow Jones Industrial Average went past 6000 yesterday, outstripping the FT-SE 100's achievement of breaking the 4000 level. These movements constitute a 27 percent increase over the last 12 months in the Dow, in comparison to a 17 percent rise in the Footsie.
